judgments.reason: The support_span 'prolonged His-ventricular (HV) interval of 75 milliseconds on first conducted beat, extending to 277 milliseconds on second conducted beat' appears literally in the ECG findings section of the clinical record, and a prolonged HV interval is a recognized electrophysiologic finding that clinically supports characterizing this Mobitz Type II block as occurring at the His-Purkinje level with prolonged His-ventricular conduction.
